Definition
[Bianchi group and discriminant] \group arithmetic-volume Source: thurston:page-0181, thurston:page-0182

For square-free $d\geq 1$, let $K=\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-d})$, let $\mathcal O_d$ be its ring of integers, and define \[ D=\begin{cases} d& d\equiv 3\pmod4,\\ 4d& \text{otherwise.}\end{cases} \] The group $\operatorname {PSL}(2,\mathcal O_d)$ is discrete in $\operatorname {PSL}(2,\mathbb C)\cong \operatorname {Isom}^+(H^3)$; every torsion-free finite-index subgroup gives an oriented finite-volume hyperbolic $3$-manifold. The lattice $\mathbb C/\mathcal O_d$ has fundamental area $\sqrt D/2$.
